name: Hides for the Forsaken
label: Quest
description: A grim necessity of undead existence in Tirisfal Glades, where the Forsaken must scavenge animal hides to replace their decaying flesh. Shelene Rhobart…
intro: A grim necessity of undead existence in Tirisfal Glades, where the Forsaken must scavenge animal hides to replace their decaying flesh. Shelene Rhobart tasks adventurers with gathering darkhound hides, duskbat wing membranes, and murloc skin to patch damaged bodies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?
Ours is a cursed life, friend. We must take from the living to further our own existence.
When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!
Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.
It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.
Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... Thick.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.
